# DeckSupervisor export contract fixture

These synthetic files were generated by the sister app's `src/features/device-export/exportPackage.test.ts` using the production TypeScript export builder. They contain Alex's classes, excluding Sam's class and waitlisted swimmers.

The second export removes Johnny, reorders rows, replaces temporary UI IDs, and changes Harrold's level. The third restores Johnny. The Go round-trip test imports these files into SQLite and verifies that attendance, earned progress, and enrollment identities survive.

To check current sister-app output, run its feature tests with `REC_TABLET_EXPORT_FIXTURES=/tmp/rec-tablet-contract`, then run this project's store tests with the same environment variable. The TypeScript test writes `initial.json`, `updated.json`, and `returned.json` there. The test needs no backend or real roster data.
